candidates.title: Cloud Cargo
candidates.mechanic: Partition finite cargo by mass and energy across shared airship bays; no trajectories, rotations, light paths, merges or timing windows.
candidates.reason: Two touch actions, explicit exact goals, independently enumerable valid solutions and measurable added constraints; readable 4/5/6-card bounded board.

candidates.title: Trace Choir
candidates.mechanic: Observe a short rhythm-free constellation of symbols then rebuild the order with tap/drag.
candidates.reason: Distinct from timing games, but memory/reveal state introduces additional accessibility and independent cognitive-difficulty validation within the same budget.

candidates.title: Fold Foundry
candidates.mechanic: Place and rotate original tiles to cover a stencil, no optical paths or merging.
candidates.reason: Distinct family, but rotation plus dragging raises 390px touch precision and geometry-solvability risks; not selected for this single commissioning.

quality_baselines_role: Completion and usability only; no supplied baseline game code/art.
